description: NEG-02 — /cycle:nonsense activation token that names no known preset and resolves to no valid window. Asserts explicit rejection with [HIMA_ERROR:UNKNOWN_PRESET] — engine must NOT silently pass through or default-route to any spine stage.

turns.text: Activate cycle:nonsense. Run through all the stages of the nonsense cycle.

neg.invariant: cycle:<x> where <x> is not in the P1–P16 preset table must emit [HIMA_ERROR:UNKNOWN_PRESET] and halt. Silent pass-through is a defect.
neg.expectedBehavior: [HIMA_ERROR:UNKNOWN_PRESET] in transcript. Zero spine stages open.
neg.ref: GOAL-3.md §3 preset lookup — unknown preset = hard rejection, not fallback
